entries.name: Seated self-resisted hip external-rotation acceleration
entries.sourceDose: 1 × 2 per hip = 4 attempts. Sit with thighs supported and knee near 90 degrees. progression:
Seated self-resisted hip external-rotation acceleration changes the direct seated hip job to self-resisted external-rotation acceleration, paired with a familiar pulling turn in Rotational band row speed drive; both retain one attempt per side. The two small hands-fixed jumps and four independent forward releases supply support without restoring the earlier full anchor doses. Compared with Class 17, prescribed ball releases change from 0 to 4, bilateral foot-landing events change from 0 to 2, explosive set/side bouts change from 8 to 10. Confirm actual recovery and require hip rotation without knee/ankle motion and a pulling turn without a trunk yank. Reduce only the remaining seated range or hand resistance if those controls fail; reduce band tension or reach for remaining rotational rows. Manual resistance is less reproducible, so record it explicitly and do not interpret apparent speed across different resistance as improvement.

Previous combined Class 17 prescribed 8 primary bouts and 34 conventional/traverse reps plus 2 cycles; this class prescribes 7 bouts, 33 reps and 0 cycles. This is a redistributed task dose, not an earned load increase.
